brief.t: START HERE: Call Solabia and obtain confirmed stock and earliest ship dates for both the open 2 kg and 30 kg Estogel requests, then alert Sam today that the stated 10 to 12 week lead time may threaten the live Roon run.

ACT NOW 1: Estogel remains a live production risk. Current Purchasing records do not verify an owner, waiting party, due date, availability, or shipment status for the 2 kg and 30 kg requests; the stated lead time is 10 to 12 weeks. The live Roon run may be exposed. No formal due date is verified. Send: Please confirm stock and the earliest ship date for both the 2 kg and 30 kg quantities today, including whether either can ship immediately.

ACT NOW 2: Container EMCU8614105 was scheduled for pickup October 7, but pickup and release are still unverified. Polo, dispatch, and PLL may be waiting; the scheduled date was yesterday, so confirmation is 1 day late. Send: Please confirm whether EMCU8614105 was released and picked up yesterday and provide the current status and any remaining charges today.

ACT NOW 3: ActivePeptide tracking remains unverified after the supplier's October 6 shipment commitment. PLL is waiting for shipment proof; tracking confirmation is 2 days late. Send: Please confirm the shipment status and send the carrier and tracking number today.
